findings.issue: WRONG. Killed total on 4 Oct 2024 is about 300 too low and inconsistent with the injured value on the same date.
findings.evidence: L'Orient Today 'War in Lebanon: human toll as of Oct. 3, 2024': MoPH total since 8 Oct 2023 = 2,011 at midnight 3-4 Oct; Minister Abiad press conference dawn 4 Oct: 1,974 killed, 9,384 injured (moph.gov.lb/en/Pages/0/75777). Series gives 1,699 killed next to 9,781 injured (injured already above MoPH 4 Oct).
findings.fix: Replace with 2,011 / sourced injured figure for 2024-10-03/04, or drop the point; re-read OCHA Flash Update for that date.

findings.issue: Date probably shifted one day. These are MoPH totals reported on 8 Oct 2024.
findings.evidence: Middle East Eye: 'By 8 October 2024 the death toll had risen to 2,083 ... 9,869 wounded'; Anadolu 9 Oct: 2,119 killed, 10,019 injured. Series dates them 2024-10-07.
findings.fix: Date 2083/9869 as 2024-10-08 (or state 'reported 8 Oct, data to 7 Oct' in notes).

findings.locator: fx_lbp_usd_official_monthly 2023-07..2023-12 vs series/D1-fx.json fx_official_monthly same months
findings.issue: Two 'official' LBP/USD series disagree for the same months: D2 85,500 (Jul-Nov 2023) and 89,500 (Dec 2023); D1 15,000 for Jul-Dec 2023 and 89,500 from Jan 2024. D2 mixes the Sayrafa platform rate into an 'official (BDL)' series. min_wage_private_usd_official_monthly is derived from the D2 version, so it jumps in 2023-12 instead of 2024-01.
findings.evidence: FAOSTAT lbn_faostat_exchange_rates.csv (HDX, CC BY-IGO): 2023-07..2023-12 = 15,000; 2024-01 = 89,500 (all 679 D1 monthly values match the file). D2 notes themselves say 'exact month of the move to 85,500 not verified'.
findings.fix: Use one official series (D1/FAOSTAT) for D2 derivations, or rename the D2 one 'BDL platform/regime rate' and keep it out of the 'official' variant.

findings.issue: Peg start date contradicted by the hub's own data: the rate was not 1,507.5 in Dec 1997.
findings.evidence: FAOSTAT monthly in fx_official_monthly: 1997-12 = 1,527.91, first 1,507.5 in 1999-01; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF 1997 = 1,539.45, 1998 = 1,516.13. Note in the series admits 'some sources date the peg to 1999'.
findings.fix: Date the first 1,507.5 point 1999-01 (or mark the step 'announced 1997, in force 1999').

findings.issue: The 89,500 step has three different start dates in the hub: 2024-02-15 here (decision date), 2024-01 in fx_official_monthly/annual (effective 31 Jan 2024 per the same file's note), 2023-12-19 in D2.
findings.evidence: Notes of fx_official_peg_steps: 'BDL decision 48/4/24 dated 15 Feb 2024 adopted 89,500 ... from 31 Jan 2024'. Sayrafa milestone file has 89,500 on 2023-12-19.
findings.fix: Use the effective date (2024-01-31) for the step and keep the decision date in notes.

findings.locator: freq vs t granularity: D1 fx_official_peg_steps (daily, '1997-12'); D2 min_wage_private_lbp_month, bread_large_bundle_pre2022_lbp, public_salary_multiplier_admin (yearly, YYYY-MM points); D3-power edl_supply_hours_households_survey (yearly, '2021-12'); D7 d7-eurobond-price-press (monthly, 'YYYY-MM-DD' points)
findings.issue: `freq` does not match the granularity of `t` in 9 series; a build that parses by freq will mis-place or drop points.
findings.evidence: Programmatic scan of all series/*.json: len(t) != length implied by freq in these series.
findings.fix: Set freq to the real granularity (e.g. 'irregular') or normalise t.

findings.issue: 363 of 538 series have license null (D2 206/207, D3-power 56/56, D7 40/106, D8 38/79, D6-war 20/37, D1 3/7). For the 56 D3-power series the README says World Bank WDI is CC BY 4.0 for the wb_* series, yet the JSON says null (all 284 wb_* values verified equal to the World Bank API). Villages: ~1,060 records have license null (D4-municipalities 1001, D4-election-districts 15, D8-caza-vital-stats 26, D8-palestinian-camps 12, D6-displacement 6).
findings.evidence: Brief rule: every record carries a licence 'as stated, or null'. Null is allowed but the stated World Bank/UNHCR/UN licences are missing where they exist.
findings.fix: Fill CC BY 4.0 on wb_* series in D3-power; keep null only where nothing is stated, and list those series in the README for Stephane's publish decision.

findings.locator: unhcr_odp_syrian_refugees and the 4 regional series, point 2026-06 (889,625; regions 286,316 / 278,523 / 238,808 / 85,978)
findings.issue: Definition break inside one series: 490,424 (2026-03) jumps to 889,625 (2026-06, +81%). Notes say the new point adds 'refugees awaiting registration'. Units/definitions mixed in one series.
findings.evidence: Series 2025-12 532,357 (matches UNHCR Refugee Data Finder year-end) then 490,424 then 889,625; regional sum for 2026-06 = 889,625.
findings.fix: Drop the 2026-06 point or put it in its own series (registered + awaiting registration).

findings.issue: WRONG or mixed unit. 2024-12 values are about 100x below the next points and the sibling series for the same month.
findings.evidence: Same series 2025-09 = 9,740 and 2025-10 = 9,859 (equal to d7-bdl-fc-gross-reserves-abl 2025-09/10); d7-bdl-fc-gross-reserves-abl 2024-12 = 10,089. 89 x 1,000 LBP bn / 89,500 is about USD 1 bn, so the point looks like LBP trillion, not USD million; foreign securities 2025-10 = 2,135.
findings.fix: Re-read the Dec 2024 ABL bulletin and convert to USD million, or remove both 2024-12 points.

findings.locator: d7-abl-total-usd, d7-abl-res-dep-usd, d7-abl-res-dep-fc-usd, d7-abl-nr-dep-usd, ... (all 'USD million (at legal rate)') point 2023-12
findings.issue: Conversion basis changes inside each series: Dec 2023 translated at LBP 15,000, Jul 2024 onward at 89,500. 115,249 -> 104,581 (total assets) is an accounting artefact, not a fall.
findings.evidence: Series note: 'LBP 89,500 per USD from 31 Jan 2024 per BDL Circular 167; LBP 15,000 for Dec 2023'.
findings.fix: Drop the 2023-12 point from these series or restate at 89,500 (and say so).

findings.issue: Points mix an upper bound and approximations as values ('less than 6 cents' stored as 6; 'around 25/30') in a series typed monthly with day dates; licence null.
findings.evidence: Notes: '2024-02 is an upper bound'.
findings.fix: Move bounds to notes or a separate qualitative table; keep only exact quotes as points.

findings.locator: attr.pop_kontur_2023 summed by adm2 vs LRP 2026 caza totals (D4-cazas/D8-caza-population-groups)
findings.issue: WRONG allocation at caza level. Summed per caza the Kontur column is up to 4x off other sources: Akkar 116,153 (LRP 2026 484,765; Landscan 2013 349,098; NPMPLT 2004 252,623), West Bekaa 38,293 (LRP 123,719), Jbeil 43,993 (LRP 131,683), Baabda 1,200,117 (LRP 568,296; Landscan 634,981). The national sum 5,365,550 is fine, so people are moved between cazas.
findings.evidence: Compared D4-cadasters sums with the OCHA LRP 2026 population package (HDX CC BY): the 208 caza values in D4-cazas/D8 match it exactly, the cadaster layer does not. Example: Mhammaret (Akkar) 10,522 vs NPMPLT 21,825.
findings.fix: Re-run the Kontur-to-cadaster join (hex centroid vs polygon) or mark pop_kontur_2023 as modelled and do not show cadaster populations next to caza totals.

findings.locator: 23 records with attr.lat = attr.lon = 0.0 (e.g. Aabbassiye and Sour, Borj Brajneh, Kornet el Hamra, SEMMAQIYEH, Zrazir, Qalb es Sabaa, Al Ansar Baalbek)
findings.issue: Null-island coordinates: map pins for these places will appear in the Gulf of Guinea; 1,001 of 1,009 rows also have license null (source impact.gov.lb).
findings.evidence: Scan of all villages/*.jsonl for lat/lon outside Lebanon: only these 23 fail.
findings.fix: Set lat/lon to null (or geocode from the gazetteer); fill or flag the licence.

findings.locator: attr.election_district null for Saida caza: 77 cadasters, 171 places, 48 municipalities (+2-5 in Beirut/null adm2)
findings.issue: Coverage gap against the brief's 'election district' per place. Saida city and most of the caza are South I; Zahrani villages are South II, so the caza-level join was left blank instead of resolved.
findings.evidence: D4-election-districts lists South I = Saida+Jezzine, South II = Sour+Zahrani ('sub-district of Saida caza in COD-AB').
findings.fix: Assign district by adm3/Zahrani sub-district: Saida/Jezzine -> South I, Zahrani -> South II.

findings.issue: Off-vocabulary governorate names; other files use 'Mount Lebanon', 'Baalbek-El Hermel', 'El Nabatieh'. Breaks grouping by adm1 and place pages.
findings.evidence: Counter of adm1 across villages/*.jsonl.
findings.fix: Normalise to the OCHA names.

findings.locator: national.voters 1,758,901 / turnout 53.98 vs sum of districts
findings.issue: Internal inconsistency: district voters sum to 1,649,391 (50.6% of the 3,257,243 district registered) against national 1,758,901; Wikipedia gives 55.2%. Three turnouts for one election.
findings.evidence: Sum of districts[].voters; national from IDEA; Wikipedia 2009 infobox 'turnout = 55.2%'.
findings.fix: Show the source for each figure and state they are not comparable, or use one source for both national and districts.

findings.issue: Turnout does not equal voters/registered: 97,347 / 476,021 = 20.45%.
findings.evidence: Computed from the same record.
findings.fix: Use the official 20.1 with its own voters/registered, or recompute.

findings.locator: cas_voters 2009 (3,258,633) and 2025 (4,081,623) vs 2009-parliamentary registered 3,258,573 / district sum 3,257,243 and 2025-municipal registered_total 4,093,663
findings.issue: Same quantity (registered voters) differs across files by 60 to 12,000.
findings.evidence: Direct comparison of the three files.
findings.fix: Reconcile or note the different register dates.

findings.issue: Not reproducible: values are 0.15-0.20 C above the current Open-Meteo archive result for the stated point (33.85N, 35.53E): 2020-07 26.82/29.75/24.05; 2015-01 10.97/15.47/7.11; 2026-09 27.00/29.92/24.14. Precipitation matches exactly. README says grid elevation 33 m; the API returns 59 m.
findings.evidence: archive-api.open-meteo.com, daily temperature_2m_mean/max/min, timezone Asia/Beirut, monthly means.
findings.fix: Say which model/parameters were used, or rebuild with the default call.

findings.issue: Mixed definitions in one series (UNICEF 'nearly' upper bound 700,000 on 2026-03-09, 'at least' counts, Red Cross counts); 2026-03-03 stored as 58,000 where IDMC's row says 58,099. idp_total_registered_2026 ends with a 2026-06-18 point (1,049,328) that the notes call 'not a new count' and 517,000 is dated 2026-03-09 where IDMC dates the same figure 2026-03-08.
findings.evidence: IDMC IDU CSV on HDX (lbn_idmc_idu_events.csv, CC BY-IGO).
findings.fix: Keep one qualifier per series, drop the plateau marker, align the 517,000 date.

findings.issue: Unverified values published: notes say they were 'read from a web-search extract of IOM's page, not fetched'.
findings.evidence: Notes of both series.
findings.fix: Verify against the IOM Round 118 page or remove before publishing.

findings.issue: Per-point provenance missing: series source_url is the ministry page but these points come from DGO/press; the 2026-09-29 point cites only a section page (https://www.sawtbeirut.com/lebanon-news/), not an article. 2026-09-04 (2,602,000 / 2,620,000 / 2,474,000 / gas 1,167,000) matches imlebanon.org.
findings.evidence: Notes list the dates and URLs; ministry site stops at 2026-08-11.
findings.fix: Cite the exact article for 2026-09-25 and 2026-09-29, or flag them as press-sourced.

findings.locator: gen_ref_diesel_lbp_20l, gen_kwh_ministry_col_lbp, gen_fixed_*: month 2026-02 missing, 2026-03 = 30 Mar table
findings.issue: Month bucketing drops a table: the ministry table dated 2 Mar 2026 (diesel 1,398,957; col 30,244) is overwritten by the 30 Mar table (1,982,753) under 2026-03, leaving 2026-02 empty. The 2 Mar table is the pre-war February reading.
findings.evidence: energyandwater.gov.lb ajax type=2: rows 30 Jan, 2 Mar, 30 Mar 2026.
findings.fix: Key tables by their period (2 Mar -> 2026-02) or keep both with day dates.

findings.issue: Unit not verified ('probably thousand LBP/month'); same concept as gen_fixed_5a_lbp_month in a different unit, so charting them together mixes x1000.
findings.evidence: Series notes: HYPOTHESIS, not verified.
findings.fix: Keep out of the comparison charts or multiply by 1,000 only after the ministry confirms.

findings.issue: Year assumed, not sourced: 'Year not stated in the extract; 2018 assumed'. Both unmet share and generator share are 37 in 2018 under different definitions, and 2022 uses two demand denominators (16,380 vs 15,117 GWh) giving 54.4% vs 76%.
findings.evidence: Series notes; arithmetic 8,913/16,380 = 54.4%, 3,648/15,117 = 24.1% supplied.
findings.fix: Mark year as estimated; show one denominator.

findings.issue: Quoted PM statement swaps damage and losses vs the World Bank RDNA (PM: 7.2 damage / 6.8 losses; RDNA 2025: damage 6,834, losses 7,164 USD million). Recorded as quoted, but not flagged as erroneous.
findings.evidence: wb_rdna2025_sector Total row.
findings.fix: Add a note that the quote reverses the RDNA split.
